title: Outriders
description: Optional fitting choice. Smaller single-seater vessels with limited range that can be launched from the main ship. Chassis, fittings, and launch options are grouped here; outrider stats apply to the outrider, not the main ship.

options.name: Workhorse Chassis
options.description: The main body of a little ship, known for consistent reliability.
options.special: Outrider base ratings: Armour 2, Seals 1, Speed 2, Saws 1, Stealth 1, Tilt 1. Gain two outrider fitting choices for free.

options.name: Skipper Chassis
options.description: Sleek and compact, made for speed and stealth above all else.
options.special: Outrider base ratings: Armour 1, Seals 1, Speed 3, Saws 2, Stealth 3, Tilt 2.

options.name: Chopper Chassis
options.description: Brutish and noisy, designed to cut through the toughest vegetation.
options.special: Outrider base ratings: Armour 3, Seals 1, Speed 2, Saws 3, Stealth 1, Tilt 2.

options.name: Sidewinder Chassis
options.description: Mobile and resilient, but lacking in speed.
options.special: Outrider base ratings: Armour 2, Seals 3, Speed 1, Saws 2, Stealth 1, Tilt 3.

options.name: Windglass
options.description: A shell of hardened amber or ancient glass affixed to an outrider's steering column.

options.name: Overburner
options.description: A chemical battery for adding extra power to the engines, used with great caution.

options.name: Mucoid Rub
options.description: A slimy adhesive coating along the lower hull, muffling engine noise and improving sharp turns.

options.name: Personal Modification
options.description: Whatever you have done to the thing, portside engineers would weep.
options.special: Increase any three outrider ratings by 1 and decrease any one rating by 1.

options.name: Weapon Housing
options.description: A mount for a larger deck weapon, with firing controls rigged to the steering column.
options.special: Deal massive LR Blunt, Keen, Spike, or Blast damage (chosen when taken).

options.name: Flatbed
options.description: A truck-style rear portion, affording a bumpy ride.
options.special: Allows the outrider to carry a small number of crew or pieces of cargo.

options.name: Camouflage
options.description: Paint and clever vegetation make the outrider almost impossible to spot at rest.
options.special: Outrider gains Stealth +3 when still or at anchor.

options.name: Tow-Line
options.description: Thickly-wound ropes or chains for towing an outrider behind the main ship.
options.special: The budget option; the outrider may get damaged in the process.

options.name: Docking Crane
options.description: A method of launching outriders from the ship's deck and retrieving them from the waves.

options.name: Wild-Bay Doors
options.description: Bay doors built into the hull that open directly to the waves, letting outriders launch and dock on their own.

options.name: Hull Clamps
options.description: Docking clamps on the outside of the ship to hold an outrider in place.
options.special: Most often used for life rafts and small transport skippers.

options.name: Catapult Track
options.description: A spring-loaded section of deck used for catapulting outriders onto the waves at speed.
options.special: Great for surprise, but getting an outrider back into place is tricky.
